title: scalar boundary comparison
statement: In an exact-functor square U⋙G≅F⋙V, a degree-two class c with scalar adjunct βκ transports to the class d under given source comparison isomorphisms. If the degree-one Kummer classes κ and κprime commute with the target comparison and with a map on unit sheaves, then the V-scalar adjunct of d is the transported boundary composed with κprime [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Apply the exact comparison functor to the scalar-adjunct equation. Use the square isomorphism naturality on Ext, the source comparison identity and the Kummer compatibility. Reassociate Yoneda products and cancel the invertible source map. The remaining terms are exactly the transported source generator and boundary; no faithfulness of forgetting scalars is used.

theorem scalar_boundary_comparison
    (τ : U ⋙ G ≅ F ⋙ V) {P Q : C} {X Y : B} {X' Y' : E} {P' : D}
    (η : X ⟶ U.obj P) (s : G.obj X ≅ X') (a : F.obj P ≅ P')
    (b : G.obj Y ⟶ Y') (β : Ext.{wB} X Y 1) (κ : Ext.{wB} Y (U.obj Q) 1)
    (κ' : Ext.{wE} Y' (V.obj (F.obj Q)) 1)
    (c : Ext.{wC} P Q 2) (d : Ext.{wD} P' (F.obj Q) 2)
    (hc : (mk₀ η).comp (c.mapExactFunctor U) (zero_add 2) = β.comp κ rfl)
    (hd : (mk₀ a.hom).comp d (zero_add 2) = c.mapExactFunctor F)
    (hκ : (mk₀ b).comp κ' (zero_add 1) =
      (κ.mapExactFunctor G).comp (mk₀ (τ.hom.app Q)) (add_zero 1)) :
    (mk₀ (s.inv ≫ G.map η ≫ τ.hom.app P ≫ V.map a.hom)).comp
        (d.mapExactFunctor V) (zero_add 2) =
      ((mk₀ s.inv).comp
        ((β.mapExactFunctor G).comp (mk₀ b) (add_zero 1)) (zero_add 1)).comp κ' rfl
